items.text: Bawuletha umphongolo kaNkulunkulu, bawubeka phakathi kwetende uDavide alimisele wona, banikela ngeminikelo yokushiswa nangeminikelo yokuthula phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Kwathi uDavida eseqedile ukunikela iminikelo yokutshiswa leminikelo yokubonga, wabusisa abantu ebizweni leNkosi.
Wanika wonke u-Israyeli, owesilisa nowesifazane, kwaba yilowo nalowo iqebelengwane lesinkwa, neqatha lenyama, nendebe yewayini.
Wamisa abathile kumaLevi ukuba bakhonze phambi komphongolo kaJehova, balobe, badumise, badumise uJehova uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli.
U-Asafa inhloko, beseceleni kwakhe uZakariya, noJehiyeli, noShemiramoti, noJehiyeli, noMatitja, no-Eliyabe, noBenaya, no-Obede Edomi; noJehiyeli ngamahabhu nezihabhu; u-Asafa wakhalisa amasimbali;
OBenaya noJahaziyeli, abapristi, benamacilongo njalo phambi komphongolo wesivumelwano sikaNkulunkulu.
Ngalolo suku uDavide wanikela okokuqala lelihubo lokubonga uJehova esandleni sika-Asafa nabafowabo.
Dumisani uJehova, nibize igama lakhe, nizazise phakathi kwezizwe izenzo zakhe.
Hlabelelani kuye, nimhubele, nikhulume ngazo zonke izimangaliso zakhe.
Zibongeni egameni lakhe elingcwele; mayijabule inhliziyo yabafuna uJehova.
Funani uJehova namandla akhe, nifune ubuso bakhe njalo.
Cabangani ngezimangaliso zakhe azenzile, izimangaliso zakhe nezahlulelo zomlomo wakhe;
Nina nzalo ka-Israyeli, inceku yakhe, bantwana bakaJakobe, abakhethiweyo bakhe!
UnguJehova uNkulunkulu wethu; izahlulelo zakhe zisemhlabeni wonke.
Khumbulani njalo isivumelwano sakhe; izwi ayala ngalo ezizukulwaneni eziyinkulungwane;
nangesivumelwano asenza no-Abrahama, nesifungo sakhe ku-Isaka;
Wasiqinisa kuJakobe saba ngumthetho naku-Israyeli njengesivumelwano esiphakade;
wathi: Ngizalinika ilizwe leKhanani, libe yisabelo selifa lenu;
Lapho nisembalwa, niyingcosana, ningabafokazi phakathi kwabo.
Bahamba besuka kwesinye isizwe besiya kwesinye, besuka kulo mbuso besiya kwesinye isizwe;
Akavumelanga muntu ukuba abaphathe kabi; yebo, wakhuza amakhosi ngenxa yawo.
Wathi: “Ningathinti abagcotshiweyo bami, ningoni abaprofethi bami.”
Hlabelelani kuJehova, mhlaba wonke! wenza insindiso yakhe yaziwe usuku nosuku.
Shumayelani inkazimulo yakhe phakathi kwabezizwe; izimangaliso zakhe phakathi kwezizwe zonke.
Ngokuba mkhulu uJehova, umelwe ukudunyiswa kakhulu; futhi uyesabeka ngaphezu kwabo bonke onkulunkulu.
Ngoba bonke onkulunkulu bezizwe bayizithombe, kodwa uJehova wenza izulu.
Inkazimulo nodumo kuphambi kobuso bakhe; amandla nenjabulo kusendaweni yakho.
Mnikeni uJehova nina zizukulwane zabantu, mnikeni uJehova inkazimulo namandla.
Mnikeni uJehova inkazimulo yegama lakhe; wenze umnikelo, uze phambi kwakhe; khonza uJehova ebuhleni bobungcwele.
Mesabe ubuso bakhe, mhlaba wonke; izwe liyakusimama, linganyakaziswa.
Malijabule izulu, umhlaba uthokoze, nabantu phakathi kwezizwe mabathi: UJehova uyinkosi.
Maluhlokome ulwandle nokugcwala kwalo; amasimu mawajabule nakho konke okukuwo.
Khona imithi yehlathi izathokoza phambi kukaJehova, ngoba uyeza ukwahlulela umhlaba.
Dumisani uJehova; ngoba muhle; ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade.
Nithi: ‘Sisindise, Nkulunkulu wensindiso yethu, usiqoqe, usikhulule kwabezizwe, ukuze sidumise igama lakho elingcwele, sidumise ekudumiseni kwakho.
Makabongwe uJehova uNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli kuze kube phakade naphakade. Bonke abantu bathi: “Amen,” futhi bamdumisa uJehova.
Wabashiya lapho phambi komphongolo wesivumelwano sikaJehova u-Asafa nabafowabo ukuba bakhonze phambi komphongolo njalonjalo, njengokufunekayo usuku ngalunye.
No-Obede Edomi nabafowabo, bengamashumi ayisithupha nesishiyagalombili; u-Obede Edomi indodana kaJeduthuni noHosa babe ngabalindisango;
noSadoki, umpristi, nabafowabo, abapristi, phambi kwetabernakele likaJehova endaweni ephakemeyo eyayiseGibeyoni;
ukuba banikele njalonjalo iminikelo yokushiswa kuJehova ekuseni nakusihlwa e-altare lomnikelo wokushiswa, benze njengakho konke okulotshiweyo emthethweni kaJehova awuyala u-Israyeli;
kanye nabo oHemani noJeduthuni nabanye abakhethiweyo ababizwa ngamagama ukuba badumise uJehova, ngokuba umusa wakhe umi phakade;
kanye nabo oHemani noJeduthuni bephethe amacilongo namasimbali abo abawabethayo, nezinto zokubethwa zikaNkulunkulu. Amadodana kaJeduthuni ayengabalindisango.
Bonke abantu basebesuka, kwaba yilowo nalowo endlini yakhe; uDavida wasebuyela ukubusisa indlu yakhe.
